code: import axios from'axios';const BASE='https://jobtrackr-api-axc0.onrender.com';const getToken=()=>localStorage.getItem('token');export const registerUser=data=>axios.post("".concat(BASE,"/auth/register"),data);export const loginUser=data=>axios.post("".concat(BASE,"/auth/login"),data);export const getAllJobs=()=>axios.get("".concat(BASE,"/jobs"),{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(getToken())}});export const createJob=data=>axios.post("".concat(BASE,"/jobs"),data,{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(getToken())}});export const updateJob=(id,data)=>axios.put("".concat(BASE,"/jobs/").concat(id),data,{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(getToken())}});export const deleteJob=id=>axios.delete("".concat(BASE,"/jobs/").concat(id),{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(getToken())}});
